chunks: And We have certainly made the Qur'an easy for remembrance, so is there any who will be reminded?
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that the Qur'an was made easy for dhikr?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the divine ease (Yassarna) of the Qur'an, countering claims of its complexity and affirming its accessibility for both intellectual reflection and spiritual contemplation. It underscores the necessity of active engagement with the text, linking the ease of recitation to the depth of its lessons for those who possess insight (mudhakkir). This ease is often interpreted as a mercy ensuring that guidance is not restricted to the elite but is available to all who seek it with sincerity.
